research_notes: The final close should avoid unnecessary extra analysis after target because close latency itself is being measured.
At the first safe boundary at/after target, capture pre_close and perform only the minimum durable close/state operations.
This yields a meaningful close-overhead observation.
Starting another large work batch after target would contaminate that measurement.
The current bounded units keep safe boundaries frequent.
The next target-crossing boundary should therefore transition directly to close.
